llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM制造的多层金属点阵结构的压溃行为，其力学测试方法可迁移至生物医用多孔植入物的力学性能评估，但未涉及应力遮挡或骨整合。
llm.why_not_core: Does not address biomedical context such as stress shielding, osseointegration, or fatigue; focuses on quasi-static crushing for structural applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究多层金属点阵结构的压溃力学行为
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM制造点阵试件并进行准静态压缩实验
summary_zh.result: 揭示了不同构型的变形模式与能量吸收特性
summary_zh.validation: 实验验证了有限元预测的变形机制

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the crushing behavior and energy absorption of multi-layer metal lattice panels fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Multi-layer lattice panels with different layer configurations were fabricated via SLM and tested under quasi-static compression.
summary_en.result: The deformation modes and specific energy absorption were characterized, showing layer-wise collapse and stable plateau stress.
summary_en.validation: Finite element simulations were validated against experimental compression tests on fabricated specimens.

papers.title: Compliant mechanisms and space grade product redesign based on additive manufacturing
papers.abstract: The use of Additive Manufacturing (AM) processes for space and terrestrial applications is a constantly growing topic of interest from the main actors in the industry. In the perspective of its future developments in the space field and for terrestrial applications, CSEM tackled the challenge of producing compliant structures based on SLM (Selective Laser Melting). In this framework, high performance stainless steel flexures with thickness below 380 micron offering bending fatigue resistance above 15 million cycles under realistic load cases were produced. On the other hand topology optimization software and specific design rules are applied to produce optimized structural parts and monolithic compliant structures. The second part of this paper describes the successful redesign of electrical SlipRings Assemblies (SRA) rotors intended for space applications. This project was run jointly with RUAG Space Switzerland, based on their expertise in the field of space grade SRAs and thanks to the know-how developed by CSEM in the field of AM-based mechanical (re)design. The novel architecture based on the combination of additive manufacturing, casting and remachining enables a significant reduction of the manufacturing and assembly costs and risks.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文针对空间应用中的增材制造机械结构设计，与生物医学植入物或骨骼修复完全无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on space-grade compliant mechanisms and slip ring assemblies, with no biomedical context, no implant design, no porous structures, and no osseointegration considerations.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索增材制造在空间 compliant 结构中的应用
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制造不锈钢柔顺机构，结合拓扑优化重新设计电滑环转子
summary_zh.result: 实现了厚度低于380微米的柔顺结构，疲劳寿命超过1500万次
summary_zh.validation: 通过疲劳试验验证弯曲疲劳性能

summary_en.motivation: To demonstrate the feasibility of additive manufacturing for producing compliant structures and redesigning space-grade components.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting of stainless steel flexures combined with topology optimization for monolithic compliant mechanisms and redesign of slip ring assemblies.
summary_en.result: Flexures below 380 micrometers achieved over 15 million cycles of bending fatigue resistance, and a novel architecture reduced manufacturing cost and risk.
summary_en.validation: Fatigue testing under realistic load cases validated the mechanical performance of SLM-produced flexures.
